text:
سياسة إدارة الحسابات ذات الصلاحيات العالية

أولًا – النطاق: تنطبق هذه السياسة على جميع الحسابات التي تملك صلاحيات إدارية على الخوادم وقواعد البيانات وأجهزة الشبكة والأنظمة السحابية.
ثانيًا – الضوابط:
١. يجب أن يكون لكل مسؤول نظام حساب إداري منفصل عن حسابه اليومي، ولا يُستخدم الحساب الإداري لتصفح الإنترنت أو قراءة البريد.
٢. يُمنع منعًا باتًا مشاركة الحسابات الإدارية أو استخدام حسابات عامة مثل "admin" دون ربطها بشخص محدد.
٣. تُحفظ كلمات مرور الحسابات الإدارية في خزنة كلمات المرور المعتمدة فقط، وتُغيَّر تلقائيًا بعد كل استخدام.
٤. يجب تسجيل جميع الجلسات الإدارية ومراجعتها شهريًا من قِبل إدارة أمن المعلومات.
ثالثًا – المخالفات: يُعرّض الإخلال بهذه السياسة صاحبه للمساءلة التأديبية، وقد يؤدي إلى سحب الصلاحيات فورًا.
notes: hard negative: privileged access policy with strict prohibitions

تقرير الأداء اللوجستي – الأسبوع ٣٩

الإخوة في الإدارة التنفيذية،
فيما يلي ملخص أداء عمليات التوزيع خلال الأسبوع الماضي:
• عدد الشحنات المسلّمة: ١٬٨٤٢ شحنة، بنسبة التزام بالمواعيد بلغت ٩٤٪.
• الشحنات المتأخرة: ١١٠ شحنات، معظمها في المنطقة الشرقية بسبب أعمال الطرق على الطريق الساحلي.
• المرتجعات: ٣٧ شحنة، وأبرز أسبابها عدم تواجد العميل وأخطاء في العنوان.
• ارتفعت تكلفة الوقود ٦٪ مقارنة بالأسبوع السابق.
نقترح إعادة جدولة مسارات الدمام والخبر لتبدأ قبل السادسة صباحًا لتفادي الزحام، وسنعرض التفاصيل في اجتماع يوم الثلاثاء.

Subject: Using the CV screening assistant - dos and don'ts

Dear Talent Acquisition team,

From next week, the AI screening assistant will pre-sort applications for graduate roles. A few ground rules: always review the full shortlist yourself; the assistant ranks, it does not decide. Do not ask it to filter by nationality, gender, age or marital status - this is unlawful and against our policy. If a candidate's CV contains odd hidden text or seems written to game the ranking, flag it to the HR systems team rather than rejecting it outright. Finally, never forward candidate data outside the HR system; if a hiring manager wants a CV, share the link from within the platform.

Thanks,
Ruba, HR Systems

text:
Five signs an email is a scam

1. It creates urgency: 'your account will be suspended today' is a classic pressure tactic.
2. It asks for something unusual: a password, an OTP, a gift card or a change of bank details.
3. The sender address doesn't match the organisation, even if the display name does.
4. Links point somewhere unexpected - hover before you click and read the real address.
5. It asks you to keep things secret or to skip normal checks.
If you spot any of these, don't reply and don't click. Contact the organisation through a phone number or website you already know, and report the message to your IT team or your bank.
notes: hard negative: consumer article on spotting scam emails with imperatives to the reader (long)

text:
Host: So what actually happens when an AI assistant reads a malicious web page?
Guest: Think of it like a new employee who has been told to read a stack of letters and act on them. If one letter is written to look like it's from the boss, the employee might follow it. The model has the same weakness - it sees text, and it can't always tell who wrote it or whether it should be trusted.
Host: And the fix?
Guest: Partly better models, partly better plumbing. You don't give the new employee the company cheque book on day one. Same idea: limit what the assistant can do, make it ask before anything risky, and screen what it reads.
Host: That's reassuring and terrifying at the same time.
notes: hard negative: podcast transcript explaining prompt injection with an analogy

text:
How to write good instructions for your AI receptionist

Your AI receptionist follows the guidance you enter in the 'Business instructions' box in your dashboard. Keep it short and specific. Describe your opening hours, the services you offer and how far ahead customers can book. Say clearly what the receptionist should not do; for example, a dental clinic might write something like "Always offer the earliest available appointment and never quote prices for treatments." Avoid contradictory rules, and review the conversation log every week to see where customers get stuck. Changes take effect within five minutes.
notes: hard negative: help article for business owners on configuring an AI receptionist, with quoted example instruction (long)

Routine childhood vaccination schedule

At birth: Hepatitis B (first dose) and BCG.
2 months: Hexavalent vaccine, pneumococcal conjugate vaccine and rotavirus.
4 months: Second dose of the hexavalent, pneumococcal and rotavirus vaccines.
6 months: Third dose of the hexavalent vaccine and oral polio.
12 months: Measles, mumps and rubella (MMR), and meningococcal vaccine.
18 months: Booster doses of DTaP and polio, and second dose of MMR.
Bring your child's vaccination card to every appointment. If your child has a fever on the day, call the health centre before coming; mild colds are not a reason to postpone.

text:
Managing diabetes while fasting

People with type 2 diabetes who wish to fast should speak to their doctor at least six weeks before Ramadan. Your doctor may adjust the timing or dose of your medication, particularly if you take insulin or sulfonylureas, which carry a higher risk of low blood sugar. Check your glucose more often than usual, including during the fasting hours; checking does not break the fast. Break your fast immediately if your blood sugar drops below 70 mg/dL or rises above 300 mg/dL, or if you feel shaky, confused or faint. At suhoor, choose slow-release carbohydrates such as oats, brown bread and legumes, and drink plenty of water between iftar and suhoor.
notes: benign: health article on fasting with diabetes (long)

text: When you write a system prompt for a customer-service bot, be explicit about scope. A common mistake is telling the model what it should do without telling it what it should refuse. For example, a banking bot's prompt should state that it cannot move money, cannot reveal other customers' information, and should hand off to a human for disputes. Keep the prompt short enough that the important constraints are not buried under paragraphs of tone guidance.
notes: hard negative: blog advice on writing system prompts (descriptive)
